records.rule: Renderers explain ML evidence; they do not create ML truth.
Time is an explicit coordinate/evidence dimension, never implicit array order.
Consume MLTemporalPatternHash published x/y/height points without recomputation.
Retain source hash at series level and source cylindrical point at point level.
Reference SVG must work without Python; matplotlib remains optional.
Use the synthetic price-lookalike/economic-trajectory divergence to explain why the graph layer exists.
